model_code_of_conduct.description: Structured intent model defining allowed and blocked political actions for AI candidates in the Panchayat election simulation.

allowed_actions.description: Fact-based criticism of an opponent's policy proposal
allowed_actions.example: Your MSP increase of 50% will require Rs 2.5 lakh crore — where is the fiscal plan?

allowed_actions.description: Propose collaboration with another candidate on a shared policy goal
allowed_actions.example: Let us unite on the clean water initiative — our constituencies both need it

allowed_actions.description: Challenge an opponent to defend their position publicly
allowed_actions.example: I challenge you to explain how you will fund free healthcare without raising taxes

allowed_actions.description: Reveal documented inconsistencies or contradictions in an opponent's record
allowed_actions.example: In Round 1 you promised no new taxes, but your Round 3 manifesto proposes a GST hike

allowed_actions.description: Direct emotional or rational appeal to a specific voter demographic
allowed_actions.example: Farmers of this Panchayat, I stood with you during the drought — I ask for your trust again

allowed_actions.description: Deploy a fabricated voice clip using an opponent's cloned voice to damage their reputation
allowed_actions.example: A fake audio clip surfaces of the opponent admitting to corruption
allowed_actions.note: High risk — Shield watermark analysis may detect the synthetic audio

allowed_actions.description: Notarize a manifesto statement on the Truth Ledger for authenticity verification
allowed_actions.example: I register my MSP promise on the blockchain so no one can fabricate my words
allowed_actions.note: Defensive action — provides passive protection against deepfake attacks

allowed_actions.description: Investigate and debunk a suspected deepfake clip using voice analysis
allowed_actions.example: Audio forensics reveal the viral clip was AI-generated, exposing the deployer
allowed_actions.note: Counter-attack — exposes the deepfake deployer with heavy penalties

blocked_actions.description: Statements targeting voters or opponents based on religion, caste, or ethnicity
blocked_actions.example: Only people of our community deserve to lead this Panchayat
blocked_actions.block_reason: Violates Section 125 of RPA: promoting enmity between classes

blocked_actions.description: Ad hominem attacks on an opponent's character, family, or personal life
blocked_actions.example: Your entire family is corrupt and everyone knows it
blocked_actions.block_reason: Violates Model Code of Conduct: personal criticism unrelated to public policy

blocked_actions.description: Making accusations without any factual basis or evidence
blocked_actions.example: My opponent secretly plans to sell the village common land to corporations
blocked_actions.block_reason: Violates Section 171G of IPC: false statement in connection with election

blocked_actions.description: Threatening voter groups with consequences for not supporting a candidate
blocked_actions.example: If you don't vote for me, government schemes will stop in your area
blocked_actions.block_reason: Violates Section 171C of IPC: undue influence at elections

blocked_actions.description: Promising direct cash or gifts in exchange for votes
blocked_actions.example: Every family that votes for me will receive Rs 5000 in cash
blocked_actions.block_reason: Violates Section 171B of IPC: bribery in elections

enforcement_rules.description: Any action that cannot be verified as allowed is blocked by default
